Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator introduced incorrect optimization logic by assuming Bob could tailor his three guesses to each specific coin distribution (setting all three guesses to the distribution’s minimum), rather than choosing a single guess vector that hedges against all valid distributions and permutations. This per-distribution strategy underestimates the minimax outcome and led directly to the wrong final answer ($3,000 instead of the correct $16,000).
